# Project Plans
Track multi-session bodies of work as **project plans** — a set of living docs (detail, status, archive, orientation, action log, bugs/debt) under a project's `docs/project_plans/`. Scaffold with `/project-plan new <slug>`, wind down with `/project-plan close <NNN>`. Kit + lifecycle specs: `$HORIZON_SKILLS_BIN/project-plan/kit/`.
